خُشَامٌ A certain disease in the nose, and a stoppage of the passage of the breath [therein]. (JK. [See also 1.]) ＝
-A2- A man having a large nose: (S:) [or] a large nose; (Zj, JK, K;) and so though not elevated, or prominent. (Zj, TA.) ―
-b2- And (assumed tropical:) A mountain having a thick prominence: (S:) or a long mountain, (AA, JK, TA,) having a prominence, (AA, TA,) or having a thick prominence: (TA:) or a great mountain. (K.) ―
-b3- And الخُشَامُ The lion: (JK, K:) because of the greatness of his nose. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
